# Non-test Go files that name the <rig>/mayor/rig path in code (gt-3lvcjz.1).
#
# Each line is: path<TAB>count<TAB>class<TAB>reason
#   count   the number of uses of the path in the file: a string literal that holds it, a
#           same-file const or var that holds it, a call whose arguments include both
#           segments (mayor and rig, literal or same-file name), a concatenation that spells
#           it, or a constants identifier (DirMayor, DirRig, RigMayorPath, RigBeadsPath) of
#           an internal/constants import. One expression that holds several forms counts
#           once. A file with more uses fails; a count the file no longer reaches fails as
#           stale, so lower it.
#   class   pending-retirement, the only class: the reason names the reader of the path
#           and the retirement that removes the use deletes the line.
#
# The list is a ratchet. TestRepoMayorRig fails on a use this file does not allow, and on a
# line whose file no longer has a use or has fewer uses than its count: fix the line in the
# retirement that removes the use. Do not add a line for new code; remove the use instead.

internal/beads/sling_context_scan.go	1	pending-retirement	sling context scan: looks for the mayor/rig checkout under a rig directory
